claims.claim: Two lion machine with overlapping table
claims.evidence: Witness report shows an antique-style treadle sewing machine on a wooden cabinet/stand with a drawer and foot pedal area; no readable brand/model text and no clear confirmation of 'Two lion' or 'overlapping table' wording.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete parts (needle, bobbin case, presser feet, attachments, belt/treadle components) which can make it unusable or require costly replacements.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the full machine with all key parts laid out (needle, bobbin case, presser feet, feed mechanism area) plus a clear view of the treadle/belt/drive connection.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/untested antique treadle machine (worst case for resale).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition unknown (treadle/handwheel may be stiff, jammed, or worn internally).
risks.proof: A short video of the handwheel/treadle being operated smoothly, showing consistent motion without grinding, sticking, or abnormal noise.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working/needs servicing until proven to run smoothly.

risks.risk: Rust, wear, or damage inside the head/feed mechanism not visible from the exterior.
risks.proof: Photos of the bobbin area and feed/needle bar region (open access panels if any) and close-ups of gears/metal surfaces for rust or missing teeth.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/possibly rusted internals (worst case).

risks.risk: Cabinet/wood damage (cracks, loose joints, wobble) affecting usability and value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cabinet joints, drawer rails, and any cracks/repairs, plus a clip showing the cabinet stable when the machine is operated.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cabinet may be damaged/needs repair.

risks.risk: Brand/model identification uncertain; value depends heavily on exact markings.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of any brand/model labels/engraving on the machine head and cabinet (including the area around decals/plates).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/unknown-brand antique treadle sewing machine.

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of all brand/model markings/labels on the machine head and cabinet (including any plates/decals).
Send a short video showing the treadle/handwheel operation (smooth movement, no grinding/sticking).
Show the bobbin case area and needle/feed mechanism close-ups (and confirm the needle and presser feet are present).
Show the cabinet condition: drawer rails, joints, and any cracks; include a clip of the cabinet staying stable during operation.
Confirm included accessories/parts (bobbin(s), spare feet, tools, belt/treadle parts if applicable).
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies an antique-style treadle sewing machine on a wooden cabinet/stand, so it can be priced at the worst case for an unverified, possibly incomplete and untested unit; key value drivers (brand/model, working condition, completeness) are not confirmed by the report.
